questions.q: How many lessons does CIS 365 contain, and how are they organized?
questions.explanation: CIS 365 has 11 lessons organized into 4 modules: Foundations, Building Blocks, Going Deeper, and Finishing Strong. You can complete them at your own pace and revisit any lesson anytime.

questions.q: What is the recommended way to practice skills in this course?
choices: Download course files to your computer
Use the built-in interactive widgets directly on each lesson page
Create accounts on external coding sites before each lesson
Watch the embedded video tutorials first
questions.explanation: Six lessons include embedded interactive widgets — a code playground, API tester, Markdown editor, Node.js sandbox, and more — so you can try things immediately without needing accounts or external tools.

questions.q: What does the 'Mark lesson complete' button do?
choices: Locks the lesson so it can't be revisited
Saves your progress and updates your overall completion count
Submits your quiz score to the instructor
Deletes your quiz answers and resets the lesson
questions.explanation: Marking a lesson complete saves your progress to this browser (and to Supabase if configured), updates the progress bar and module trackers, and keeps your place so the home page can show you where to continue next.
